name: MD RandomSentences2
author: minadiaz

sections.description:
You can add, delete, and edit sentences from the “RandomSentences” menu in your WordPress admin panel.

In the pro version, you can customize fonts with over 1,000 Google Fonts and add smooth jQuery animations.

How do I display the sentences on my website?

Use the shortcode [md_randomsentences2] to display random sentences.

Can I customize the appearance of the sentences?

Yes! The free version allows custom CSS styling. The premium version lets you choose Google Fonts and enable animations.

Is the plugin compatible with my theme?

Yes, MD RandomSentences 2 works with any well-coded WordPress theme.

How do I upgrade to the premium version?

Visit our official page for details on upgrading to the premium version.

Support

If you need assistance, contact us through:

📌 Support email: lospluginsdemina.com@gmail.com

We are happy to help!
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the ZIP file.
  4. Click Install Now and wait for the installation to complete.
  5. Click Activate Plugin.
  6. Go to RandomSentences in your admin menu to start adding sentences.
  7. Use [md_randomsentences2] in any page, post, or widget to display random sentences.
